name: Bharat Singh Bhati
title: Software Developer · Machine Vision · IoT · On-Device AI
summary: Computer Science Engineering graduate with hands-on experience building AI, Machine Vision and IoT systems. Experienced in Python, C++, PyTorch, OpenCV, Whisper, YOLO, embedded systems, Linux and Docker. Built fully offline AI assistants, embedded IoT solutions and computer vision applications with a strong focus on edge computing and real-world deployment.
